title: 數一數：迴圈跑幾次
question:
程式快不快，可以看「n 變大時，要做幾次」。請輸入 n，數三種迴圈各跑了幾次：
1. 一層迴圈：i 從 0 到 n - 1
2. 兩層迴圈：i、j 都從 0 到 n - 1（迴圈裡面還有迴圈）
3. 每次砍半：k 從 n 開始，k 大於 1 就 k = k / 2（無條件捨去）
輸出「一層：幾」「兩層：幾」「砍半：幾」。
想想看：n 變成 10 倍，三種各變成幾倍？這就是 O(n)、O(n²)、O(log n)。

test_case.output:
一層：10
兩層：100
砍半：3

test_case.note: n 變 10 倍：一層變 10 倍、兩層變 100 倍

en.title: Count the Loop Steps
en.question:
Is a program fast? Look at how many steps it takes when n gets big. Input n and count how many times each loop runs:
1. One loop: i from 0 to n - 1
2. Two loops: i and j both from 0 to n - 1 (a loop inside a loop)
3. Halving: k starts at n; while k is bigger than 1, k = k / 2 (round down)
Output "One loop: ", "Two loops: " and "Halving: " with the counts.
Think: when n is 10 times bigger, how many times bigger is each count? This is O(n), O(n²) and O(log n).

test_case.note: n is 10 times bigger: one loop 10 times, two loops 100 times
